rationale: As a factory producing spices and binders for kebab/gyros, the platform should feel grounded, warm, and tactile. Replacing generic SaaS 'tech blue' with organic earth tones (terracotta, sage, warm sand) establishes industry context while maintaining clear CRM functionality.

surface_styles.cards: bg-white border border-[#E8E3DB] shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow

buttons.primary: bg-[#C15C3D] text-white hover:bg-[#A84E31] rounded-lg px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-colors shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-[#4A6741] text-white hover:bg-[#3B5233] rounded-lg px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-colors shadow-sm
buttons.outline: border border-[#E8E3DB] text-[#2D2A26] hover:bg-[#F5F2EB] rounded-lg px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-colors
buttons.ghost: text-[#757169] hover:text-[#2D2A26] hover:bg-[#F5F2EB] rounded-lg px-4 py-2 transition-colors

components.tables: Use Shadcn Table. Apply bg-[#FBF9F6] to headers with text-xs uppercase tracking-wider text-[#757169]. Row hover should be bg-[#F5F2EB].
components.inputs: Use Shadcn Input. bg-white border-[#E8E3DB] text-[#2D2A26] focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#C15C3D]/20 focus:border-[#C15C3D]
components.maps: React Map GL (or equivalent) with a custom Mapbox style emphasizing warm tones (light beige/sand). Use primary color (#C15C3D) for route paths and markers.

images.description: Plate surrounded by spices and herbs. Use for auth/login screen background, empty states, or as a subtle textured header background in the recipe module.
Modern food production plant interior. Use for factory management screens or Daily Reports headers.
Miniature truck traveling on a map. Perfect for the Route Planner module's empty state or intro card.

module_specific_guidelines.dashboard: Follow 'Control Room Grid'. Top row: 3-4 summary metric cards (col-span-1). Middle row: Wide analytical chart (col-span-2 or 3) + Calendar/Visit Planning widget (col-span-1). Bottom row: Recent orders feed. Use Recharts with the earthy color palette.
module_specific_guidelines.leads_and_orders: High-density data tables. Utilize Shadcn's Sheet or Drawer component for quick-viewing lead/order details instead of full page redirects to preserve context.
module_specific_guidelines.recipes_and_specifications: Bento-style layout for managing spice/binder formulas. Use visual progress bars in the secondary color (#4A6741) to show ingredient percentage limits. Specifications should have a distinct 'PDF preview' pane.
module_specific_guidelines.route_planner: Split view: 1/3 list of stops on the left, 2/3 interactive map on the right. Map styling MUST feel integrated into the app (avoid default Google Maps colors; aim for desaturated, warm tones).
module_specific_guidelines.lead_finder: AI-powered tool interface. Use the accent color (#E4A753, ochre/amber) for an 'AI glow' or badge to separate this intelligent feature from standard CRM actions. Include a 'scanning' micro-interaction during searches.

testing.requirements: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include 'data-testid' attributes in kebab-case format based on role (e.g., 'submit-order-button', 'lead-row-123', 'add-ingredient-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the B2B CRM dashboard for Gewürzberg GmbH using React, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI. Strictly adhere to the 'Organic & Earthy' palette to give the interface a physical, grounded feel appropriate for a spice and binder factory. DO NOT use generic SaaS blue. Ensure data density using 'IBM Plex Sans' for body text, while maintaining an approachable feel with 'Outfit' for headers. Customize Shadcn UI borders, backgrounds, and shadows to match the warm stone/sand theme defined in this JSON. Ensure responsive 'Control Room' grid layouts for all dashboard views.
